recurring.title: Stoughton Sea Shanty Society Sing
recurring.desc: Join members of The Stoughton Sea Shanty Society as we sing old songs and new songs mostly of a maritime, historical, and workers theme at our every fourth-Sunday community sing at Mershon's Cidery on Main Street in Stoughton, WI! And drinking songs… did we mention drinking songs? It pairs perfectly with the ciders, wines, and ale available at Mershon's!
